errors.text_span: След това линията се покачва до около 0,70% през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The line reaches a value of approximately 0.70% in 2014, not 2017. The year 2017 corresponds to the peak of the graph.

errors.text_span: достига връх от приблизително 3,10% през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The peak value in 2017 is visibly below the 3.00% gridline, at approximately 2.9%. The reported value of 3.10% is an overestimation.

errors.text_span: и завършва в 2019 г. с приблизителна стойност от 2,50%
errors.evidence: The final value in 2019 is approximately 2.7%, which is slightly higher than the value in 2018. The description's value of 2.50% is an underestimation and misses this upward trend.

errors.text_span: Между 2015 и 2016 г. може да се забележи участък без промяна, ако не броим малките флуктуации.
errors.evidence: The line shows a clear, albeit small, decrease from approximately 0.2% in 2015 to approximately 0.1% in 2016. It is not a 'section without change' (plateau). The description misrepresents the trend in this segment.
